text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Doses of 2.5 mg (2,500 mcg) of octreotide acetate injection subcutaneously have caused hypoglycemia, flushing, dizziness, and nausea. Contact Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) for latest recommendations.
